description: Does an entry for this origin country, food or company appear in Japan's MHLW inspection order documents for imported foods? Returns listed, not_listed_in_current_documents or unknown, with each matching row as published (food, test items, conditions, company and exemption lists), its document, version (file id, SHA-256), page and first_seen_at. Food names are matched in Japanese as in the documents. Not legal advice; confirm with the quarantine station.

country.description: Optional: country of origin in English or Japanese, or ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, e.g. China, 中国 or CN. Rows for all exporting countries are included

food.description: Optional: food name in Japanese as in the documents, e.g. 落花生 (peanuts), ナチュラルチーズ, ほうれんそう

hs_or_item_text.description: Optional: other item text to find anywhere in a row (e.g. a test item such as アフラトキシン). An HS code is accepted but the documents do not list HS codes, so it cannot be matched

limit.description: Maximum number of rows to return, 1-200 (default 50)

manufacturer.description: Optional: manufacturer, exporter, packer or plant name as spelled in the documents (at least 3 letters), e.g. COFCO

name: import_order_lookup

label.description: Attachment label as on the MHLW page, e.g. 別添1 (attachment 1) or 別表3 (annexed table 3).

version_observed_at.description: When this service first downloaded this version of the document.

fields.description: The row as published (NFKC-normalized), field names as in the document.

first_seen_at.description: When this service first observed this entry (see first_seen_note).

official_check.description: Read first: check the official MHLW notice page and confirm with the quarantine station before importing.

provenance.description: Freshness receipts for every upstream source used.

items.description: Freshness receipt for one upstream source.

fetch_status.description: found / empty / stale / unavailable / unsupported (see catalog fetch_status_values).

retrieved_at.description: When this service retrieved the upstream data (null if unknown).

source.description: Publisher and URL of the upstream document or dataset.

upstream_updated_at.description: Update time stated by the upstream, or null when it states none.

status.description: listed = matching entries appear in the current published documents (see matches and their role); not_listed_in_current_documents = none found in the documents read (not a statement that no requirement applies); unknown = stale, not loaded, a document in scope could not be read reliably, or the query cannot be matched.

terms.description: URL of the terms of service.

title: Japan imported food inspection order lookup
